aboutH2: Cedars Supportive Recovery Living: Sober Living Homes in Surrey, BC
intro: Cedars Supportive Recovery Living is the sober living arm of Cedars Recovery, the residential treatment centre in Cobble Hill on Vancouver Island. Until recently the homes went by Acorn Recovery Living, and the old acornrecovery.ca address now forwards to Cedars. This is supportive recovery living, not treatment: there is no detox and no medical program here. People move in after finishing treatment at Cedars, at another centre or in the community, and live in a staffed house with others in early recovery while they rebuild work, study and daily routines.

Acorn Recovery Living is a sober living program that aims to provide continued support to individuals in early recovery. The program is a part of Cedars at Cobble Hill, which is renowned for providing top-notch addiction treatment services throughout North America. The program follows an integrative healing approach that emphasizes the importance of mind, body, and spirit in recovery, along with community support, family systems, social involvement, and recreation. Clients participate in a structured program that includes group accountability sessions, in-house and community-based 12-Step meetings, meal preparations, and morning check-ins. The extended care program is designed to teach valuable life and social skills within a supportive environment.

pillars.title: Location and Accommodation
pillars.body: Acorn Recovery Living is located in Surrey, the urban community of British Columbia that offers various recreational opportunities within walking distance or a 10-minute drive. The region’s ideal location also provides easy access to Vancouver and the US border. The program offers comfortable, gender-specific accommodations in upscale residential homes that ensure a peaceful and relaxing environment for individuals in recovery.

pillars.title: Staff and Support
pillars.body: Acorn Recovery Living boasts a team of compassionate and knowledgeable staff members who are themselves in recovery. Each staff member serves as a manager and elder in the house community, reflecting the values and teachings of recovery while offering the necessary structure and support throughout the program. All activities take place in group meetings, where residents can interact, learn from one another, and build a strong support system.

pillars.title: What a Stay in the Homes Includes
pillars.body: Cedars lists what comes with a stay: round-the-clock staff on site, access to one-on-one counselling sessions, a recovery coach, three clinician-led process groups each week, regular attendance at community support groups and life skills work. Residents can look at returning to work or going back to school while they live in the house, and some use the time to keep going with the work they started in treatment. Extra clinician-led groups from Cedars' Supportive Recovery Programming can be added, and families can join the Discovery Family Program run by Cedars.

overviewH2: Cedars Supportive Recovery Living: Center Overview
overview: Acorn Recovery Living by Cedars is committed to helping individuals achieve their ultimate goal of a successful recovery. Offering long-term support in their Surrey homes, Cedars’ transitional living program provides a safe and healthy environment for individuals to transition into following their departure from the inpatient treatment centre. The research has shown that ongoing care is crucial to achieving and maintaining sobriety; this is something Cedars prioritizes and ensures this type of care is available. The recovery homes provide both men and women the opportunity to rebuild their lives while continuing to receive guidance on recovery management.

At Acorn Recovery Living, Cedars’ staff is devoted to helping individuals gain the skills and confidence needed to maintain their recovery. For some, incorporating structured recovery management strategies is a challenge. Cedars’ Acorn Recovery Living staff provides guidance and support to those who need it the most. Through a comprehensive approach towards treatment, patients are taught essential principles and given the support necessary to achieve their goals of a lasting recovery. With a competent and compassionate team by their side, individuals are guided through the rigors of early recovery to achieve their ultimate goal of a successful and long-term recovery.

location.heading: Cedars Supportive Recovery Living in Surrey, British Columbia
location.intro: The listed recovery home is at 6811 135A Street in the Panorama Ridge area of Surrey, in the Lower Mainland south of the Fraser River. The BC Assisted Living Registry lists three registered Cedars recovery homes on this block, at 6811, 6817 and 6847 135A Street. Cedars itself describes its homes as being in a quiet community on the edge of Surrey near White Rock. Downtown Vancouver is about 40 minutes away by car, Langley and White Rock about 20 minutes, Abbotsford about 45 minutes and the Peace Arch border crossing about 25 minutes. The Cedars treatment campus in Cobble Hill is about 3 hours away with the Tsawwassen ferry.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing, the Cedars website and recovery.com. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.a: Acorn Recovery Living is a sober living program that provides continued support to individuals in early recovery.

faqs.q: Is Cedars Supportive Recovery Living a treatment centre? Does it offer detox?
faqs.a: No. It is supportive recovery living, a sober living home for people who have already finished treatment, and it has no detox or medical program. Cedars runs detox and residential treatment separately at its Cobble Hill campus on Vancouver Island.

faqs.q: Is Acorn Recovery Living now called Cedars Supportive Recovery Living?
faqs.a: Yes. The homes are now presented as Cedars Supportive Recovery Living, and acornrecovery.ca forwards to the Cedars Recovery website. Google still lists the Surrey home as Acorn Addiction Recovery Homes by Cedars.

recovery.com estimates $3,000 for a 30-day stay, paid privately. Cedars does not publish the fee on its own site, and the price can change with the length of stay, so confirm it with admissions at 1-866-716-2006.

faqs.q: How long is the program at Acorn Recovery Living?
faqs.a: The program length varies based on individual needs and circumstances.

faqs.q: Where is Acorn Recovery Living located?
faqs.a: Acorn Recovery Living is located in Surrey, British Columbia.

faqs.q: What is included in a stay?
faqs.a: Cedars lists 24/7 staff on site, access to one-on-one counselling, a recovery coach, regular community support groups, three clinician-led process groups a week and life skills development. Residents can also return to work or school during their stay.

faqs.q: What is the approach to recovery at Acorn Recovery Living?
faqs.a: Acorn Recovery Living follows an integrative healing approach that emphasizes the importance of mind, body, and spirit in recovery, along with community support, family systems, social involvement, and recreation.

faqs.q: Who can enroll in Acorn Recovery Living?
faqs.a: Acorn Recovery Living is available to anyone seeking sobriety and support in early recovery, regardless of individual circumstances.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodations does Acorn Recovery Living provide?
faqs.a: Acorn Recovery Living offers comfortable, gender-specific housing in upscale residential homes.

faqs.q: Are family members allowed to visit at Acorn Recovery Living?
faqs.a: Yes, family visitation is allowed as a part of the recovery process.
